verdict.rationale: Increase documents Check Transfers: it prints and mails physical checks for you, holds the funds, and tracks each check through mailing, deposit and returns, which covers check issuance. The evidence only says funds can be received 'via ... checks' and doesn't document check deposit with image capture. missing for 10: check deposit / remote image capture API, explicit API endpoint documentation for check issuance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, checks still work — programmatic check issuance and check deposit with image capture, because real businesses still receive and send paper

citations.quote: Check Transfers let you send a physical check without operating a printer or a mailroom. Increase prints and mails the check on your behalf, holds the funds until it's deposited, and tracks it through mailing, deposit, and any returns.
Push money out via same-day ACH, Real-Time Payment, check, or virtual or physical cards.
With ACH and Check returns automatically correlated with their originating transfers, it’s simple to track and resolve exceptions.
receive funds via ACH, wires, checks or Real-Time Payments
